title: WebGL: 2D and 3D graphics for the web - Web APIs | MDN
key_points: WebGL is a JavaScript API for rendering high-performance interactive 3D and 2D graphics within any compatible web browser.
It can be used in HTML <canvas> elements.
The API closely conforms to OpenGL ES 2.0, allowing it to take advantage of hardware graphics acceleration provided by the user's device.
WebGL does not require plug-ins for rendering graphics.
limitations: No publisher or publication date information available on the source page.
asserts: WebGL is a JavaScript API that allows developers to render high-performance interactive 3D and 2D graphics in web browsers without requiring additional plug-ins.
scope: The scope of this assertion is limited to WebGL's capabilities within web browsers for rendering graphics.
